newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Lanka tenders to buy July 12-13 diesel, jet.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka tenders to buy July 12-13 diesel, jet.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy gas oil and jet fuel for July 12-23 delivery, cost and freight (c-and-f) Colombo, a CPC official said on Wednesday.
The tender, which seeks a 250,000 barrels of 1.0 percent sulphur gas oil and 50,000 barrels of jet fuel, closes June 18 and offers should be valid for two days.
CPC is expected to award its tender to buy its fourth diesel cargo for June delivery on Thursday.
CPC has raised middle distillates imports for June due to the unexpected shutdown of its 55,000 barrels-per-day Sapugaskandan refinery, after its single point mooring buoy was damaged in an accident.
Sri Lanka normally imports two or three cargoes of middle distillates each month.
The refinery resumed operations on Tuesday, officials said on Wednesday.
